categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including multiple notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public projects (water supply, drainage projects), amendments to previous land acquisition notices, and corrections to land parcel details. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative procedures, property descriptions, and acquisition processes without involving government personnel changes, structural reforms, or other specialized categories.
